configurations.name: ROS2: Launch Nav2 Bringup (nav2_bringup_custom)
configurations.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /workspace/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch nav2_bringup_custom nav2_bringup.launch.py

configurations.name: ROS2: Create World (create_world)
configurations.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /workspace/install/setup.bash && ros2 run create_world world_supervisor.py

configurations.name: ROS2: Spawn Robot (auto: SLAM if no map, else AMCL)
configurations.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /workspace/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch spawn_robot spawn_robot.launch.py robot_id:=${input:spawnId} x_pose:=${input:xPose} y_pose:=${input:yPose}

configurations.name: ROS2: RViz (for spawn_robot, namespaced tb3_XX)
configurations.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /workspace/install/setup.bash && RVIZ_SRC=$(ros2 pkg prefix spawn_robot)/share/spawn_robot/rviz/spawn_robot_view.rviz && RVIZ_TMP=/tmp/spawn_robot_view_tb3_${input:rvizRobotId}.rviz && sed 's/tb3_01/tb3_${input:rvizRobotId}/g' $RVIZ_SRC > $RVIZ_TMP && rviz2 -d $RVIZ_TMP --ros-args -r /tf:=/tb3_${input:rvizRobotId}/tf -r /tf_static:=/tb3_${input:rvizRobotId}/tf_static -r __ns:=/tb3_${input:rvizRobotId}

configurations.name: ROS2: Build Map (Auto: explore_lite, auto-save)
configurations.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /workspace/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch spawn_robot build_map.launch.py exploration_mode:=auto

configurations.name: ROS2: Build Map (Manual: keyboard teleop)
configurations.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /workspace/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch spawn_robot build_map.launch.py exploration_mode:=manual

configurations.name: ROS2: Teleop Keyboard (for Manual mode)
configurations.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /workspace/install/setup.bash && ros2 run teleop_twist_keyboard teleop_twist_keyboard --ros-args -p stamped:=true -r cmd_vel:=/tb3_${input:buildMapRobotId}/cmd_vel_nav2_raw

configurations.name: ROS2: Save Map (for Manual mode)
configurations.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /workspace/install/setup.bash && ros2 topic pub --once /tb3_${input:buildMapRobotId}/save_map_trigger std_msgs/msg/Empty {}

configurations.name: ROS2: Spawn Robot (force AMCL)
configurations.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /workspace/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch spawn_robot spawn_robot.launch.py robot_id:=${input:spawnId} x_pose:=${input:xPose} y_pose:=${input:yPose} slam:=false
